category_title: Preschoolers who throw tantrums during cleanup transitions
scenario_title: Transitioning from dramatic play to cleanup
minimal_context: Olivia is playing in the dramatic play center of the preschool classroom and needs to clean up her items.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Olivia, playtime is over. It is time to clean up the dramatic play center.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Continues her dramatic play) No, I am still playing!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to put the items away now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't want to clean up!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We have to clean up the toys.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Drops to the floor sobbing, crying loudly, and screaming)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Olivia, playtime is over. It is time to clean up the dramatic play center.

STUDENT: (Continues her dramatic play) No, I am still playing!

TUTOR: You need to put the items away now.

STUDENT: I don't want to clean up!

TUTOR: We have to clean up the toys.

STUDENT: (Drops to the floor sobbing, crying loudly, and screaming)

task.content: Clean up items after dramatic play
task.learning_goal: Decrease the duration of tantrums (e.g., less than 1 min) by providing Olivia with a visual and/or verbal reminder prompt to indicate that playtime would be ending

context.environment: Mr. Cho's preschool classroom, dramatic play center
context.materials: Visual and/or verbal reminder prompt, visual supports, transition cues, choice board, first/then board

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When Mr. Cho prompts her to clean up
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Dropping to the floor sobbing, crying loudly, or screaming.

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Throws tantrums primarily when Mr. Cho prompts her to clean up
